items.title: Accessibility statement
items.description: Draft prototype template for content review. This is not an approved organisational policy.

paragraphs: The prototype uses semantic headings, labelled form controls, keyboard focus styles and responsive layouts. Search has text-based results and recovery guidance. English and Kiswahili navigation labels are available; page content remains English.
A complete assistive-technology audit has not been performed. External assets require a network connection, and reference report and audio files are unavailable.
Use the contact page to describe the page, task and assistive technology involved. An approved accessibility statement and remediation process are required before launch.

items.title: Medical information disclaimer
items.description: Draft prototype template for content review. This is not an approved organisational policy.

paragraphs: This prototype presents proposed service and resource content. It does not diagnose a condition or replace an individual assessment by a qualified health professional.
Confirm available services, eligibility, dates and referral arrangements directly with the clinical team. Demo campaign registration does not reserve an appointment.
Resource summaries, service claims and clinical material require review and approval before a public launch.

items.title: Privacy policy
items.description: Draft prototype template for content review. This is not an approved organisational policy.

paragraphs: The demo enquiry and newsletter forms do not transmit or save their entries. Theme and navigation-language preferences may be stored in your browser. Search terms appear in the page address and browser history. External font providers receive normal web requests when fonts load.
Replace this draft with an approved policy identifying the responsible organisation, purposes of processing, lawful grounds, retention periods, recipients, rights and a privacy contact.
Use the contact page to ask about the prototype. Do not submit patient information.

items.title: Safeguarding policy
items.description: Draft prototype template for content review. This is not an approved organisational policy.

paragraphs: Community health activities should treat children, young people and adults with dignity, respect and appropriate protection from harm.
An approved policy must define reporting channels, designated safeguarding responsibilities, consent, conduct, supervision and escalation arrangements.

headings: This prototype is not a reporting channel
paragraphs: Do not enter safeguarding reports or identifying details into the demo forms. Reporting contacts must be confirmed and published before launch.

items.title: Terms of use
items.description: Draft prototype template for content review. This is not an approved organisational policy.

paragraphs: Pages, figures, profiles, schedules and editorial material demonstrate a proposed website. They do not confirm service availability, appointments, qualifications or partnerships.
The logo and reference materials are supplied for this prototype. Publication permissions and ownership statements need confirmation before launch.
An approved version should identify the operator, acceptable use, content permissions, service limitations and how disputes or changes are handled.
